activity: AL with walk ups and scales landing on 1,3,5

notes:
3rd Sept - New scales (minor melodic) workflow:
- Practise some minor melodic scales with two hands.
- Now practise a minor melodic scale from the ones you just got acquainted, play in the RH. With LH, play an associated Root and shell. For an ALTERED sound, play a dominant root and shell ONE SEMITONE down from your RH melodic minor scale
- ^ We're taking scales we know, and associating the chord to THAT
- Now some IDEAS within the scale (forget the LH for a second) - Find the two major triads in the MM scale. (hint they are also in the MAJOR scale of the same name) - practise the triads in the 3 inversions. And now start to blend scales and the arpeggiated triads together.
- NOW when the scale and triads (which give you arpeggios) are feeling intuitive, we start to introduce LINE CONSTRUCTION elements: so enclosures, walk ups. All of this, when you gain confidence, introduce the root and shell in LH.
